uncle-robert-s-geography-uncle-robert-s-: Educator Francis Wayland Parker believed children learn geography best through stories, and this book proves it. Uncle Robert takes his young visitors on imagined journeys across the country, turning maps into adventures. Part of a beloved series, it taught generations of schoolchildren to see the wider world with curious eyes.
the-great-conspiracy-volume-3: The third volume carries the war through 1862 — Shiloh, Antietam, and the Emancipation Proclamation. Logan writes as both soldier and statesman, never doubting the Union cause. Stirring history from one who helped make it. From the Peninsula to Antietam's cornfield, Logan follows the armies with a soldier's eye and a patriot's heart.
cecilia-or-memoirs-of-an-heiress-volume-: The third volume brings Cecilia's trials toward their moving close — madness, despair, and at last, happiness earned. Burney's great novel ends as it lived: with wit, feeling, and moral grace. A satisfying finale. Delirium, devotion, and a hard-won happy ending crown one of the age's finest novels.
